text:
Kiran (Design): quick check: I sketched a tighter create token card that surfaces "visibility" inline so people stop opening 3 different places to find their token. please quick eyes.
Bea (PM): TL;DR: reduce support DMs, keep power-user flow fast.
Arjun (Eng): Heads up: adding recorded vs ephemeral affects storage & audit. We'll need a flag on create and audit events.
Lila (A11y): Make sure 'shown once' is part of the visible label. Use aria-describedby to link to the short explainer.
Kiran (Design): UI idea: under "Name" put a compact row: Visibility: [o] Ephemeral — shown once  [ ] Recorded — stored & auditable. Small info link "why recorded" that opens tooltip. Default Ephemeral.
Bea (PM): Default Ephemeral makes sense. Add a docs link in the success toast: "Learn about token lifecycle".
Arjun (Eng): For recorded we'll persist to vault + emit `token.created.recorded`. Ephemeral keeps existing flow (only shown once). Need infra review.
Lila (A11y): When the secret is shown, announce: "This token will be shown only now" via aria-live, and when copying say "Token copied to clipboard". Also ensure download has descriptive filename and announcement.
Kiran (Design): Microcopy swaps: change reveal CTA to "Copy token (shown once)" and small secondary "Download .env (contains token)" to make it explicit.
Bea (PM): Rotation behavior: propose a toggle in the rotate modal: "Enable grace (soft-revoke)" with inline helper: "Keep old token valid for X hours to allow rollout". Default off.
Arjun (Eng): Backend supports configurable grace window. Suggest default soft=24h and hard immediate revoke with 15m undo (hard revoke still emits `token.revoked.hard`). We'll add `token.revoked.soft` if grace is used.
Lila (A11y): Modal focus must land on the confirm button; Esc should announce "Modal closed". Toggles must be implemented as real checkboxes with aria-describedby.
Kiran (Design): Revoke confirmation copy: replace vague "Are you sure?" with "Revoke token — immediately disables clients. Undo available for X." When soft=on show 24h, otherwise 15m.
Bea (PM): Experiment idea: Variant A show visibility inline at create. Variant B keep create simple and surface visibility only in advanced settings after creation. A/B test for support volume and create-time completion rate.
Arjun (Eng): Inline variant adds `visibility` + `audit_recording` to create API; modal-only is lower risk. I'll estimate after designs.
Kiran (Design): List row tiny status chip: Active / Revoked (soft) / Revoked (hard). Keep chip text for colorblind users; tooltip with next steps.
Lila (A11y): Chips need text content and aria-labels like "Revoked (soft) — undoable for 24 hours". Tooltips must be keyboard-focusable.
audit-bot: audit-bot: "Flagging infra-impact: epic-778 token-visibility (KMS + audit retention)."
Bea (PM): Next steps: Kiran will post two small frames, Arjun gives effort estimate by EOD, Lila posts checklist, I'll schedule security sign-off. Thanks all :raised_hands:
